description: This PHP class, 'ContactsParseRule', extends the 'BaseRule' and implements parsing logic for contact-related panels in different views ('DetailView' and 'EditView') within the SuiteCRM platform. It performs pattern matching on panel data to replace or modify fields such as 'name' fields and 'portal_password' fields, adapting the form or display elements accordingly.

classes.name: ContactsParseRule
classes.description: A class that defines rules for parsing contact panel data in SuiteCRM views, specifically handling name fields and portal password fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the ContactsParseRule class. Currently, it does not perform any initialization.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Processes panels in 'DetailView' to replace name fields with 'full_name'.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Processes panels in 'EditView' to replace the portal password field with a custom HTML input element.
